registration.role: single-factor arm lookback240 on the 441-day rung, seed 29
registration.status: covered by the screen10 pre-registration; not separately registered
registration.note: a draft may not escalate, replace the incumbent or be reported as a candidate until the paired ten-window test passes

question_zh: 在 441 天 rung（2022-01-04..2023-10-31）的 1.32 个有效 epoch 预算下，只改 data.lookback 是否让十个开发窗（203 个交易日）的池化 RankIC 相对441 日同种子基线出现超过门槛的配对提升。
hypothesis: With the 441-day CSZ rung fixed, a 240-bar input window (60 quarters per scale, 600 total dimensions instead of 320) improves the out-of-sample cross-sectional RankIC of the 1.32-point checkpoint on the ten development windows, relative to the same rung's 128-bar three-seed blend, by more than the pre-registered floor on a paired trading-day basis. Seed 29.

factor.note: a single recipe field moves off the 441-day rung; the training window, the seeds, the sampler cost and every other setting stay fixed

environment_only_changes.note: path-only changes required by the training host: data and cache live on the container-local disk, run artifacts under /mnt/work (network disk that survives a container restart)

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the registered budget point governs the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as the upper bound (must exceed the last budget point)
budget_only_overrides.data.splits.train.start: unchanged from the 441-day rung (2022-01-04); this arm moves no window
budget_only_overrides.note: any other deviation from the arm recipe must fail the run guard

budget_points.name: screen10-stepup-1.33
budget_points.role: throw-away step-up point (+1,100 optimizer steps): exists only because validate_budget_points demands two strictly increasing points; never scored, never exported for comparison

exposure.reconcile: samples_seen == steps * batch_size; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; realised effective epochs within atol of the declared point
exposure.min_coverage_note: shuffle feeds every usable row once per epoch, so coverage is 1.0 from the scored point on; the rung's contract is untouched.

resume.fail_closed: pool, recipe, fitted transforms and sampler batch order must reproduce the checkpoint exactly
resume.note: the two budget points are checkpoints of one uninterrupted trajectory, not two runs

derived_reference.calibration: level-1 measured 1054256 usable samples over 132 trading days, scaled linearly by trading days; the driver re-derives both from the pool actually built

deviation_tolerance.rule: a realised value beyond +/-5% stops the run and reports; the estimate is not edited afterwards

derived_reference.steps_expected_rule: steps = round(effective_epochs * usable_rows / batch_size); run_training_trajectory derives the budget from the pool it measured at prepare_training time, never from the plan static estimate

steps_evidence.hz-t3: prepare_training on the real 441-day pool returned usable_samples=3521680 (/root/logs/smoke-screen10-2point-rankhinge-s11.json)
steps_evidence.hz-4: archived 441d rung run budget.json: usable_samples=3521680, point scaling-1.32 steps=145269 (20261027T191119.061322Z_2303ea6816b5)
steps_evidence.why_it_matters: both machines measure the same 3521680 rows, so both derive 145269 at 1.32 and 146370 at 1.33; comparability rests on effective epochs, not on the plan stale estimate

concurrency.sharing: packed by the memory pre-flight, not by a fixed map

evaluation_scope.cloud: validation split 2023-11-01..2023-11-15 = 10 trading days, process diagnostic only
evaluation_scope.formal: the five declared research windows produced locally by replaying exported per-budget-point weights; a cloud validation score is never the delivery evidence

facts: a 256-bar lookback was exercised inside the Patch 256 (dual_patch) family, not on mlplob
no recorded mlplob arm has moved the window off 128 bars
prior_evidence.confound: the bar projection cache is content-addressed by source/columns/date range only, so the 441-day cache is reusable unchanged: the window width changes nothing else

driver_anchor.name: screen10-1.32 first, screen10-stepup-1.33 second
driver_anchor.why: a 0.66 anchor can reach at most steps*batch/usable = 0.6600 coverage, so reconcile_exposure rejects a [0.66, 1.32] trajectory right after the anchor; putting 1.32 first keeps both points >= 1 epoch (coverage reaches 1.0) and leaves the scored point's full exposure guarantee intact for +1,100 steps instead of +72,634
driver_anchor.equivalence_claim: the 1.32 checkpoint is one continuous trajectory with the same seed, sampler order and total step count; the step-up point runs after it and its weights are never replayed

approved_by: captain 2026-10-28, option 1: scored-first [1.32, 1.33], R1 min_coverage 0.99, R2 min_coverage 1.0
non_scored_point_exclusion: the 1.33 checkpoint, its predictions and its metrics are never compared; every replay reads only the 1.32 weights

driver_compatibility.rule: validate_budget_points: two points, strictly increasing effective epochs
driver_compatibility.step_rule: steps = round(effective_epochs * usable_samples / batch_size), re-derived by the driver
